'''Tarisian Roses''' were from the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Few survived the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of Taris.

==Behind the scenes==
Tarisian Roses first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as courting gifts for companions.
